source_text: We sequenced a 1290 bp fragment of the AChE gene in twenty mosquitoes, fifteen from Mozambique (8 bendiocarb resistant and 7 susceptible) and five from Cameroon (fully susceptible to all insecticides (C. Wondji, Unpublished)). The G119S mutation that confers carbamate and organophosphate resistance... was not observed in these samples.
